title: Obben Rorr Electric Sportbike 100kmh
description: Representing Obben Electric's prowess in the Middleweight Sportbike class, the Obben Electric Obben Rorr Electric Sportbike 100kmh is delivers razor-sharp chassis feedback for riders hunting apexes. A 100cc powerplant pumps out 12 HP and 10 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Aggressive Forward Tuck layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
